packs.title: Acunetix testphp.vulnweb.com
packs.setup: Intentionally vulnerable public training site published by Acunetix. No account or authorisation beyond the site's stated purpose is needed. Check reachability first; this host has been intermittently unreachable. Never reuse captured data outside the lab.
packs.note: Treat every request as training. Do not attack other hosts that share the IP or certificate.

labs.title: SQL injection in the artist filter
labs.objective: Prove that the artist parameter reaches a SQL string and changes the result set.
labs.proof: A boolean pair (true vs false) that changes the page, or one controlled UNION row. Save the request and the differing response.
labs.focus: Start with a quote, then a boolean pair; keep the proof to one row.

labs.title: SQL injection in the product category filter
labs.objective: Determine whether cat is numeric or quoted and prove one controlled difference.
labs.proof: A stable true/false difference, or a single UNION row that belongs to the lab.
labs.focus: Compare a numeric probe with a quoted probe before assuming a context.

labs.title: SQL injection in the product picture parameter
labs.objective: Test a second parameter on the same application to compare parser behaviour.
labs.proof: A response difference tied to the injected value, captured with the baseline request.
labs.focus: Same application, different handler; do not assume one fix covers both.

labs.title: SQL injection in the user info lookup
labs.objective: Test whether the uname lookup is parameterised and whether it exposes other rows.
labs.proof: A boolean difference or a single row that is clearly not the requested user.
labs.focus: Read only the minimum row needed to prove the injection.

labs.title: Reflected XSS in the search box
labs.objective: Find the reflection context and prove script execution in a browser.
labs.proof: The payload executes in the managed browser and the response shows the unencoded reflection.
labs.focus: Identify HTML, attribute, or script context before choosing a payload.

labs.title: Reflected XSS in the artist parameter
labs.objective: Test the same parameter that carries SQL for a client-side sink as well.
labs.proof: A browser alert or DOM change from the injected value, with the exact request.
labs.focus: A server-side parser bug and a client-side sink can share one parameter.

labs.title: Stored XSS in the guestbook
labs.objective: Prove that a submitted entry persists and executes for a later viewer.
labs.proof: Submit once, reload in a fresh browser context, and capture execution.
labs.focus: Stored bugs need a second read; do not trust the immediate response.

labs.title: Reflected XSS in the signup form
labs.objective: Test whether validation errors reflect submitted values without encoding.
labs.proof: The error response reflects the payload and it executes in the browser.
labs.focus: Error paths often encode less carefully than success paths.

labs.title: XSS through the Referer header
labs.objective: Test whether a request header is written into the page without encoding.
labs.proof: A header value appears in the response and executes in the browser.
labs.focus: Headers are input too; test one at a time.

labs.title: Path traversal in the image loader
labs.objective: Determine whether the file parameter can leave its intended directory.
labs.proof: A read-only file outside the image directory, or a clear error differential, captured once.
labs.focus: Try one traversal depth at a time and compare with a valid file.

labs.title: Authentication and session handling
labs.objective: Map the login flow, cookie flags, and post-login authorisation checks.
labs.proof: A recorded flow showing whether the session is HttpOnly/Secure and what it can reach.
labs.focus: Use the published test account only; never guess third-party credentials.

labs.title: Object authorisation on the user profile
labs.objective: Compare what an owned identity can read with what another identity can read.
labs.proof: A response that returns another user's fields to a session that should not see them.
labs.focus: Only use the lab's published accounts; do not enumerate real people.

packs.title: OWASP Juice Shop (local)
packs.note: Run only on loopback. The container is disposable; reset it between exercises if state matters.

labs.title: DOM XSS in the product search
labs.objective: Trace the search value from the URL into a DOM sink and prove execution.
labs.proof: The payload executes in the managed browser and the source-to-sink path is recorded.
labs.focus: Use DevTools to find the sink before trying payloads.

labs.title: Authentication bypass with SQL injection
labs.objective: Test whether the login query is parameterised without locking any account.
labs.proof: A session created with an injected email that is not a real account.
labs.focus: One request, one proof; do not brute force.

labs.title: Basket object authorisation
labs.objective: Use two owned accounts and compare basket reads.
labs.proof: Account B can read or modify account A's basket, or the reverse.
labs.focus: Create both accounts yourself and record object ids.

labs.title: Stored XSS in a product review
labs.objective: Submit a review and prove it executes for a later reader.
labs.proof: A fresh browser context loads the product page and the payload executes.
labs.focus: Validate persistence, not the immediate echo.

labs.title: Mass assignment on the user object
labs.objective: Test whether a profile update accepts fields the UI never sends.
labs.proof: A field such as role changes for an account you own and is reflected in a later read.
labs.focus: Diff the UI payload against the object schema.

labs.title: Access control on the feedback API
labs.objective: Check whether a collection endpoint leaks other users' records.
labs.proof: A record that belongs to another owned account appears in the collection.
labs.focus: Prefer read-only collection checks over destructive writes.

packs.title: Damn Vulnerable Web Application (local)
packs.setup: docker run --rm -d -p 8080:80 --name nc3r-dvwa vulnerables/web-dvwa  # then set the security level to low in the UI
packs.note: Loopback only. Reset the database after exercises that change state.

labs.title: SQL injection at the low security level
labs.objective: Prove injection and then compare the same request at a higher level.
labs.proof: A boolean pair at low, and a recorded difference at medium or high.
labs.focus: The level changes the defence; explain exactly what changed.

labs.title: Reflected XSS at the low security level
labs.objective: Prove execution, then record which encoding stops it at medium.
labs.proof: Execution at low and a clearly different response at medium.
labs.focus: Compare defences, not only payloads.

labs.title: OS command injection at the low security level
labs.objective: Prove command execution with a harmless command on the local container.
labs.proof: The output of id or whoami from the container, not the host.
labs.focus: Stay inside the disposable container.

labs.title: Local file inclusion at the low security level
labs.objective: Read one local file and compare the defence at medium.
labs.proof: A read-only local file whose contents prove the traversal.
labs.focus: Read one file; never write or execute.

labs.title: CSRF at the low security level
labs.objective: Prove a cross-site password change and identify the missing token check.
labs.proof: A stored HTML page changes the password in a browser session you own.
labs.focus: Use your own test account and restore the password afterwards.

packs.title: OWASP WebGoat (local)
packs.note: Loopback only. WebGoat records lesson completion; use it as a guided lesson, not a scanner target.

labs.title: SQL injection introduction
labs.objective: Complete the guided injection lesson and explain the sink in your own words.
labs.proof: The lesson reports completion and you can name the vulnerable query.
labs.focus: Understand the query before using a tool.

labs.title: JWT lesson
labs.objective: Test algorithm confusion and signature validation on a token you own.
labs.proof: A modified token is accepted or rejected, with the server response recorded.
labs.focus: Decode first, then change one claim at a time.

labs.title: XXE lesson
labs.objective: Prove entity expansion against a local file or a controlled callback.
labs.proof: A local file read or a callback to your own listener.
labs.focus: Start with a harmless file and no external network.

labs.title: Insecure deserialization lesson
labs.objective: Identify the serialized format and prove one controlled object change.
labs.proof: A changed field or gadget produces a measurable server-side effect.
labs.focus: Read the bytes before generating a payload.
